definitions.explanation: The act of two or more things joining together into one. Used for physical combinations, organizational mergers, and in anime/manga for characters or robots merging.

examples.japanese: ⟦{二|ふた}つ→二つ：02953_futatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{合体|がったい}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦ロボット→ロボット：06404_robotto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{合体|がったい}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{巨大|きょだい}→巨大：02586_kyodai⟧ロボ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The robots combine to form a giant robot.

examples.japanese: ⟦{異|こと}なる→異なる：02101_kotonaru⟧⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{合体|がったい}⟦させる→する：00392_suru⟧ことで、⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧にない⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生|う}まれた→生まれる：00905_umareru⟧。
examples.english: By combining different technologies, an entirely new product was created.

notes:
USAGE:
Used as a suru verb: {合体|がったい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to combine/merge). Particularly well-known in anime and tokusatsu (special effects shows) culture, where characters or machines merge into a single, more powerful form. Also used in general contexts for mergers and combinations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {合体|がったい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to combine, to merge
- {合体|がったい}ロボ: combining robot
- {合体|がったい}⟦{技|わざ}→技：02172_waza⟧: combination technique/move

SIMILAR WORDS:
{合体|がったい} emphasizes physically joining into one body. ⟦{合併|がっぺい}→合併：04778_gappei⟧ is used for organizational mergers (companies, municipalities). ⟦{融合|ゆうごう}→融合：14036_yuugou⟧ means blending or fusing, often for abstract concepts or cultural mixing. ⟦{統合|とうごう}→統合：09615_tougou⟧ means integration or consolidation of systems or organizations.
